name: Stolen Blasting Powder

angles.text: Gol'Bolar Quarry supports Ironforge's stonecraft and excavation. Letting troggs weaponize mining explosives so near King Magni's doorstep is a humiliating failure for a dwarven supervisor.
Dun Morogh's supply lines and stone works matter to the Alliance's mountain stronghold. Guarding dangerous munitions helps keep the nearby High Seat in Ironforge safe.
Blasting powder clears rock and opens veins in deep digs, but it takes discipline to handle. Losing bulk kegs to wild cave-dwellers is every quarrymaster's nightmare.

faq.answer: Quarrymaster Thesten oversees excavation at Gol'Bolar Quarry in Dun Morogh. After a great stockpile of industrial blasting powder goes missing under his watch, he needs help recovering it.
The troggs carried the powder to the crags and dens immediately east of Gol'Bolar Quarry. You are sent to recover the volatile kegs and sacks before disaster strikes.
faq.q: Where can the stolen blasting powder be found?

aliases: what do troggs want with powder
faq.answer: The entry gives no reason for the troggs' theft. They scavenged the powder kegs from quarry workers, and Quarrymaster Thesten fears they may ignite the explosives through clumsy experimentation.
faq.q: Why did the troggs steal the blasting powder?

faq.answer: Quarrymaster Thesten says the missing keg could blast King Magni's throne room into an open-air courtyard. If it detonates in the enclosed quarry or caverns, the force would be devastating.
faq.q: How dangerous is the stolen blasting powder?

faq.answer: When you return the powder, Quarrymaster Thesten pays you and asks you to keep the incident quiet. He gives no reason, but losing so much explosive to the troggs is something he would rather conceal.
faq.q: Why does Quarrymaster Thesten want the incident kept quiet?

faq.answer: Gol'Bolar Quarry is a dwarven excavation site in eastern Dun Morogh. It quarries stone for construction and engineering across the realm, while troggs emerge from the rock into its deep pits.

sections.body: At Gol'Bolar Quarry in Dun Morogh, dwarves use heavy blasting charges to break stone and open deep veins. But primitive troggs from the nearby crags stole a bulk shipment of high-grade powder. Quarrymaster Thesten needs capable hands before the pack causes an accidental detonation.
sections.title: A Missing Stockpile

sections.body: The missing keg holds enough force to reduce King Magni Bronzebeard's grand throne room to an open-air courtyard. The troggs carried the powder east to their rough foothill camps. Left alone, they may soon discover fire or strike stone against spark.
sections.title: A Powder Keg in the Crags

sections.body: After the stolen charges are recovered from the troggs and returned to the quarry depot, Quarrymaster Thesten can breathe easy. He rewards you, then quietly asks that you tell no one about the incident.
sections.title: Quiet Resolution

summary: At Gol'Bolar Quarry, Stolen Blasting Powder has gone east with the troggs. Quarrymaster Thesten needs help recovering the missing munitions before the brutes set them off by accident.
attribution: In-game quest text: Stolen Blasting Powder
